title: jacobaea ferganensis
intro: Jacobaea ferganensis, commonly known as Ferghan daisy, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Jacobaea ferganensis include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
